editorial.meta_description: The DSST Principles of Supervision exam evaluates management functions including planning, organizing, and leading to determine if candidates qualify.
editorial.overview: The Principles of Supervision exam, offered by DSST, evaluates knowledge of management functions. It covers six distinct domains: Role of Supervisor, Planning & Decision Making, Organizing, Staffing, Leading, and Controlling. This computer-based, multiple-choice exam is a standard assessment for those seeking college credit for supervisory knowledge. It is available for $85 for civilians, while eligible military personnel may access it through DANTES. The exam structure ensures that candidates demonstrate their grasp of the primary responsibilities inherent in modern supervisory roles.
editorial.who_should_take: This exam is designed for individuals seeking college credit for their supervisory knowledge. It is suitable for those with professional experience or training in management roles who want to demonstrate their understanding of supervisory functions and decision-making processes in a professional environment.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Review the six domains of the exam to ensure familiarity with management functions. Utilize textbooks or management guides that cover planning, organizing, leading, and controlling. Practice applying these concepts to various workplace scenarios. Since the exam consists of 100 questions, focus on understanding the terminology and frameworks used in supervisory roles. Check with DSST for the current certification path and additional study resources to prepare for the test.

domain_guidance.summary: This domain covers the fundamental responsibilities, professional expectations, and core duties placed on a supervisor within an organization, ensuring candidates understand the scope of their role and management expectations in a modern business environment.

This domain focuses on the processes involved in setting organizational goals and making informed business decisions, requiring candidates to demonstrate proficiency in strategic planning and the application of various decision-making models in professional settings.

This domain addresses the structural aspects of management, focusing on how tasks are delegated, arranged, and coordinated within an organization to achieve efficiency and ensure that all operational goals are met through proper organizational design.

This domain covers the recruitment, selection, and ongoing management of personnel within a team, emphasizing the importance of staffing procedures and effective personnel management to maintain a productive and capable workforce for the organization.

This domain examines the various methods used to influence, motivate, and guide employees toward achieving organizational objectives, focusing on different leadership styles and techniques for fostering employee motivation within a diverse and dynamic professional team.

This domain covers the systematic monitoring of performance and the implementation of necessary corrective actions, ensuring that supervisors can effectively track progress toward goals and address any deviations from established standards within the workplace.

editorial.exam_day_guidance: The exam is a 120-minute computer-based test. Ensure you arrive prepared for a 100-question session. Manage your time effectively across the six domains to complete all sections within the allotted duration and achieve the required passing score of 400.

faq.question_title: How many questions are on the exam?
faq.answer_text: The Principles of Supervision exam consists of 100 multiple-choice questions. Candidates should be prepared to answer all of these items within the allotted time to demonstrate their understanding of the supervisory concepts covered in the test.

The official passing score for this DSST exam is 400. Candidates must meet or exceed this score to successfully earn college credit for their knowledge of supervisory principles and management functions as evaluated by the assessment.

The total exam duration is 120 minutes. This time limit is designed to allow candidates sufficient opportunity to work through the 100 multiple-choice questions while carefully considering each scenario and applying their management knowledge to the provided options.

faq.question_title: How much does the exam cost?
faq.answer_text: The exam price is $85 for civilians. It is provided free of charge for eligible military personnel via DANTES. Please verify your eligibility status before scheduling your appointment to ensure you are aware of the correct payment requirements.

methodology.summary: This page was built by synthesizing official DSST exam documentation and verified facts regarding the Principles of Supervision exam structure, requirements, and scoring criteria to provide accurate guidance for all prospective test takers.
